Monochrome glass / menu AI expansion / responsive feedback
One liquid language, different amounts of energy.
Compress gently; release to rest. A soft ripple marks touch.
Retarget from the current position. No waiting for repeat taps.
Shallow stretch and crossfade; keep navigation stable.
Expand from the trigger; dismiss along the same path.
One drop, a controlled stretch, then a quiet settled panel.
No drop, ripple, stretch or travel. Keep feedback legible.
